title: Elucidating the impact of common stormwater pollutants on antibiotic resistance: the role of heavy metals, nutrients, and salts
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00032G, Paper
Kassidy O'Malley, Patrick McNamara, Walter McDonald
This research aimed to assess how common stormwater pollutants affect antibiotic resistance. Findings revealed that heavy metals increased antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) levels, while nutrients and salts had no effect.
